series.title: Seoul Starter · 서울 생활
series.description: Jisoo has just moved to Seoul for a new job. Follow her first days in the city: a friendly neighbor, convenience stores, subway lines and a brand-new office.
series.style_prompt: Bright, clean Korean webtoon style with crisp line art and soft cel shading; modern Seoul streets, small red-brick apartment buildings, convenience stores, offices and subway stations; soft natural daylight, warm pastel palette, friendly expressive faces. No text, letters or speech bubbles in the image.

characters.name: Jisoo
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean woman, 28, shoulder-length straight black hair with soft see-through bangs, warm brown eyes, slim build; casual look: cream knit cardigan over a white T-shirt, light-blue jeans, white sneakers and a small tan crossbody bag; office look: navy blazer over a white blouse. Bright, slightly nervous smile.

characters.name: Minho
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean man, 28, tall, short tousled dark-brown hair, friendly crescent-shaped eyes and an easy grin; at home a gray hoodie, black joggers and slippers, outside a navy bomber jacket with earphones around his neck. Relaxed, helpful body language.

characters.name: Yuna
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean woman, 31, chin-length dark bob tucked behind one ear, small silver earrings, the same friendly crescent-shaped eyes as her younger brother Minho; office look: beige blouse, navy slacks, ID badge on a lanyard. Confident, warm, big-sister energy.

characters.name: Clerk
characters.appearance_prompt: Young Korean man, early 20s, convenience-store clerk, short neat black hair, round glasses, green-and-white store uniform vest over a white shirt with a plain blank name tag (no writing), polite cheerful expression.

characters.name: Team Leader Kim
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean man in his late 40s, neatly combed short black hair with a little gray at the temples, rectangular glasses, dark suit, white shirt and navy tie; calm, kind but serious expression.

episode.title: 첫 출근 · First Day at Work
episode.synopsis: On her first day at the Gangnam office, Jisoo greets Team Leader Kim in formal speech, meets her friendly coworker Yuna and has lunch at Yuna's favorite restaurant. On the way home Yuna says her younger brother also lives in Sinchon, and the door she knocks on is right next to Jisoo's. Minho opens it and calls Yuna 'noona'.

panels.image_prompt: Morning in Gangnam: tall glass office towers glittering in the sun, commuters walking with coffee cups; Jisoo in a neat navy blazer and white blouse stands at an office building entrance, gripping her bag strap and taking a deep breath.

bubbles.translation: Monday morning: her first day at work.

tokens.note: Target word: 출근 = going to work (퇴근 = leaving work); 출근하다 = to go to work.

bubbles.translation: I'm so nervous... I can do this!

tokens.note: Target word: 긴장되다 = to feel nervous; 긴장돼 is how you say it to yourself.

tokens.lemma_translation: to be able to do, can do
tokens.note: V-(으)ㄹ 수 있다 = can V; 할 수 있어! = 'I can do it!'

panels.image_prompt: A bright open-plan office with plants and monitors; Jisoo bows deeply in front of Team Leader Kim, a neat man in his late 40s with glasses, who has stood up from his desk and nods with a calm smile.

bubbles.translation: Good morning! I'm Kim Jisoo. I start work here today.

tokens.lemma_translation: to be well, at peace (used in greetings)
tokens.note: Speech-level switch: formal 합쇼체 (-ㅂ니까/-ㅂ니다) is used for greetings at work, especially to a boss.
부터 = from (a time): 오늘부터 = starting today.
Target word: 일하다 = to work (일 work + 하다 do).
N입니다 = formal 'I am N'. At work people give their full name, family name first.

bubbles.translation: Nice to meet you, Jisoo. Welcome.

tokens.note: Target word: 환영하다 = to welcome; 환영합니다 = 'Welcome!'

panels.image_prompt: Team Leader Kim gestures toward Yuna, a woman in her early 30s with a chin-length bob, beige blouse and an ID lanyard, who waves at Jisoo from her desk with a big friendly smile.

bubbles.text: 이쪽은 박유나 씨예요. 많이 도와줄 거예요.
bubbles.translation: This is Park Yuna. She'll help you a lot.

tokens.lemma_translation: this side, this way; this person (polite)
tokens.note: 이쪽은 N이에요/예요 = a polite way to introduce someone: 'This is N.'
V-(으)ㄹ 거예요 = will V (future or prediction).

bubbles.translation: Hi! Looking forward to working with you, Jisoo.

tokens.lemma_translation: to be well, at peace (used in greetings)

tokens.translation: looking forward to working with you
tokens.lemma_translation: please take good care of me (set phrase)
tokens.note: 잘 부탁해요 is a friendlier version of 잘 부탁드려요 from episode 1.

panels.image_prompt: Yuna shows Jisoo a clean, empty desk next to a big sunny window, with a new computer and a small potted plant; Jisoo's eyes sparkle.

tokens.note: 지수 씨 자리 = Jisoo's desk: the possessive 의 is often left out. Name + 씨 can also mean 'you'.
Target word: 자리 = seat or spot; in an office, your desk.

bubbles.translation: Wow, it's by the window! I love it.

panels.image_prompt: Lunchtime at a cozy, busy Korean restaurant near the office: Yuna and Jisoo sit across from each other with bubbling kimchi stew, bowls of rice and small side dishes; Yuna grins proudly while Jisoo takes a happy first bite.

bubbles.translation: It's the best place near the office. Tasty, right?

tokens.note: Target word: 맛집 = a place known for great food, a must-know word in Korea.
Target word: 맛있다 = delicious (맛 taste + 있다 have).

panels.image_prompt: Late afternoon at the office in warm orange light: Team Leader Kim, wearing his coat, gives a small nod on his way out; Jisoo, packing her bag, stands up and bows politely.

tokens.note: Target word: 수고하셨습니다 = 'Thanks for your hard work', said to colleagues at the end of the day.
Set phrase: 내일 뵙겠습니다 = formal 'See you tomorrow' to a boss.

panels.image_prompt: Evening on a crowded subway train: Jisoo and Yuna stand side by side holding the hand straps and chatting, city lights blurring past the windows.

tokens.note: Koreans often say name + 씨 instead of 'you'.
Target word: 살다 = to live; 어디 살아요? = Where do you live?

panels.image_prompt: Close-up on the subway: Yuna claps her hands together with a delighted expression; Jisoo smiles next to her, a little surprised.

bubbles.text: 어, 제 동생도 신촌에 살아요! 같이 가요.
bubbles.translation: Oh, my younger brother lives in Sinchon too! Let's go together.

tokens.note: 제 = my (polite). Don't mix it up with 제가 = I (subject).
Target word: 동생 = younger brother or sister (남동생 / 여동생 to be specific).

panels.image_prompt: The familiar hallway of Jisoo's red-brick building at night: Yuna stops in front of the door right next to Jisoo's apartment and presses the doorbell; behind her Jisoo freezes, wide-eyed, looking from one door to the other.

bubbles.translation: Huh...? But this is Minho's place...?

tokens.note: -(이)ㄴ데 trails off with 'but…', leaving the surprise unsaid.

panels.image_prompt: The door swings open: Minho in his gray hoodie and slippers, holding a bag of snacks, freezes in shock as he sees Yuna and, right behind her, Jisoo; dramatic speed lines, comedic surprise.

bubbles.translation: Hey sis, you're here? Huh...? Jisoo?!

tokens.note: Target word: 누나 = what a man calls his older sister, or an older female friend.
